title: Score invariance under an unused coordinate change
statement: Let $p\in\mathbb{R}$, let $T$ be a finite decision tree on sign-valued inputs using a set of available coordinates, and let $x$ be a sign-valued input. If coordinate $j$ is not available to the tree, then replacing $x_j$ by any sign leaves the biased query score of $T$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite decision tree on sign-valued inputs
$x$ is a sign-valued input on $n$ coordinates
$j$ is not among the available coordinates
The replacement value is a sign
